research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Amobee is engaged in developing technology for demand segmentation and forecasting in media inventory allocation. This involves determining forecasted attributes for scheduled media items based on observed characteristics of previously presented media items. The technology identifies divisions of scheduled media items into multiple media segments based on these forecasted attributes, enhancing media inventory management and allocation strategies.

overview_description.description:
Advertising solutions that unify, optimize and grow your business.

Finally, there’s a platform that understands how people consume content today. A platform that understands that as people move across screens, advertisers and broadcasters need to adapt instantly.

Only Amobee makes it easy for you to find your audience—no matter where they are, no matter what they’re watching. Amobee is built on three fundamental truths: consumers move fluidly across screens, love video, and value their privacy.

Amobee helps brands, agencies, and media companies unify audiences to optimize results across all TV, connected TV, and digital media, including social, to drive customers’ growth.

product.name: Nexxen DSP
product.description: A demand-side platform that enables advertisers to engage audiences across TV, connected TV, and digital media by optimizing reach and frequency.

product.name: Nexxen SSP
product.description: A supply-side platform that helps broadcasters optimize revenue from TV and digital media through audience-based selling and cross-platform tools.

product.name: Nexxen Ad Server (Nexxen CTRL)
product.description: An ad server that manages and delivers advertising campaigns across TV, CTV, and digital media, integrated with the SSP as Nexxen CTRL.

product.name: TV Amplifier
product.description: A tool that extends linear TV audience targeting to connected TV, digital, and social media for coordinated video advertising strategies.

product.name: 4Screen Reports
product.description: A reporting tool that provides holistic audience measurement across all screens to understand consumer actions through the marketing funnel.

product.name: Upfront and NewFront Deal Optimization
product.description: A service that uses audience insights and forecasting to improve the value and effectiveness of linear TV advertising deals.
